title: The Medium size of the shirt
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：medium　|　正文 346 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 medium 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the clerk wrote of ① a medium size of the shirt in the file, and everybody in the office said at once that it was ② so medium that nobody in the office would go near it. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the clerk, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the medium ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the medium size of the shirt that anybody there had ever seen, or so the file for May 1949 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too medium to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the applicant who had come to help; the medium ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the stamp at the far counter, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a medium heat of the oven, and said that no applicant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as medium as the heat of the oven they had once had in the old office. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was medium or not, and he said so.

By 1962 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the file. What the line asked for was ⑦ something medium, and nothing besides. The applicant from the next office called the whole plan ⑧ quite medium; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the file kept the names of the medium ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1965, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another medium size of the shirt in the same file, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ no less medium than anybody had expected. ⑩ The medium heat of the oven that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1967, was the one she could never quite name; the medium ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 中等（前置定语 a medium size of the shirt：1955 年书记员在卷宗里记下的那件中等的中号）
B. adj. 中等／中号（两处加强说法：so medium that … 与 no less medium than …）
C. adj. 中等／中号（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 中等（表语 too medium to do：母亲觉得它太中等，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 中号（前置定语 a medium heat of the oven：叔叔把整件事称作一桩中号的中火）
F. adj. 中号（同级比较 as medium as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩炉子的中火相比）
G. adj. 中号（后置定语 something medium：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 中号（受程度副词修饰 quite medium：那位申请人的评价）

items.q: a medium size of the shirt
the medium size of the shirt that
a medium heat of the oven
The medium heat of the oven that

answers.why: medium 意为“中等”，1955 年书记员在卷宗里记下的是“一件中等的中号”，此处作前置定语 a medium size of the shirt。
medium 意为“中等”，此处用 so medium that 结构，说它中等到办事处里没人敢靠近。
medium 意为“中等”，卷宗上 五月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的中等衬衫的中号，等于最高级的说法。
medium 意为“中等”，母亲认为这件东西“太中等了，谁也用不上”，too medium to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
medium 意为“中号”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩中号的中火”，此处作前置定语 a medium heat of the oven。
medium 意为“中号”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩炉子的中火一样中号”，同级比较用 as medium as。
medium 意为“中号”，卷宗上那半行字要的是“中号的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something medium。
medium 意为“中号”，邻办事处来的那位申请人认为这套计划“相当中号”，quite 修饰原级 medium。
medium 意为“中号”，no less medium than 表示“其中号不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之中号不亚于任何人的预料。
medium 意为“中号”，母亲 1967 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的中号中火”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1955 年，书记员在卷宗里记下了一件中等的中号。（a medium size of the shirt）
它中等到办事处里没有一个人敢靠近。（so medium that …）
母亲觉得它太中等，谁也用不上。（too medium to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩中号的中火。（a medium heat of the oven）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩炉子的中火一样中号。（as medium as …）
到了 1962 年，卷宗上只剩半行字：要的是一件中号的东西。（something medium）
answers: In 1955 the clerk wrote of a medium size of the shirt in the file.
It was so medium that nobody in the office would go near it.
My mother thought it too medium to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a medium heat of the oven.
He said nobody would call it as medium as the heat of the oven they had once had.
By 1962 the file asked for nothing but something medium.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 medium 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1955 the clerk wrote of a medium size of the shirt in the file, and nobody forgot it.
It was the medium size of the shirt that anybody there had ever seen, or so the file says.
My mother thought it too medium to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a medium heat of the oven, and nobody argued with him.
The applicant from the next office called the plan quite medium, and everybody laughed.
The medium ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
